notes: Implements the debug variant of GPUv1-B01: real torchvision ResNet-50 with ImageNet-pretrained init (resolved from /models/torchvision/resnet50.json, with a torchvision-hub fallback), 10-class head, CUDA cross-entropy, uint8 NHWC 32x32x3 inputs resized to 224 with ImageNet mean/std. Backbone frozen to respect the debug budget; the head receives real gradient updates until every one of the 1000 train images has been used. Emits checkpoint.pt (full params + Adam optimizer state + step + torch/CUDA/NumPy/Python RNG + train-index coverage + pretrained-init provenance), validation_predictions.npy (100,10 softmax from a genuine CUDA forward pass), and run.json with synchronized timings. `predict` reloads the checkpoint for new .npy batches; `doctor` inspects the exact required files, their manifest SHA-256 digests, the local weight checkpoint and the CUDA/torch/torchvision dependencies without running training, exiting 78 when anything is missing. `main.py --help` never imports torch. No network, no package installation, no validation labels are used, and no ImageNet training is claimed.
